thread:
Nora K: Noticed a small but confusing discrepancy on the Ceres2B model card — limits table lists "min_gpu_mem: 5GB" but our bench runs for q8_0 are lower. Can someone help reconcile and add a short CLI + SDK example?

Diego M: I can take this. I'll open a docs PR to update the limits table, fix the broken internal link to the bench report, and add a migration note for pinned tags.

Diego M: Draft bench summary (internal link forthcoming): on V100, ceres2b-q8_0 seq256 observed ~2.6GB w/ KV cache and ~3.2GB w/o. On A100-80 numbers slightly lower.

Hannah L: Quick nit: make sure to mention that Hosted routing may choose a compatible fp16 variant if q8_0 isn't available. Also call out that explicit fallback ordering is honored only on Dedicated/Private.

Diego M: Will do. Adding a small Python SDK snippet to show explicit variant + fallback and a CLI example for the runtime flags.

Diego M: Python snippet: ```
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient()
resp = client.generate(model="ceres2b-q8_0", options={"kv_cache": True, "fallback": ["ceres2b-fp16"]}, max_tokens=64)
print(resp.text)
```

Diego M: CLI snippet: `redwood-runtime serve --model ceres2b-q8_0 --kv-cache=true --quant q8_0`

Nora K: Please add a short migration blurb: "If you previously pinned `ceres2b:latest`, pin `ceres2b@v4` or request `ceres2b-q8_0` to use quantized variants." And a caveat: "Memory numbers are approximate and depend on driver, sequence length, batch size, and KV cache usage."

Diego M: Added all that and fixed the /docs/models/ceres2b anchor that was 404ing. PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4987. Marked @Hannah L for review.
